Rejected spec fix still assigns its items to the sprint
note: bugs.txt pt 17, seen again 2026-10-24: spec fix refused (sprint file over 6144 B) but items got sprint:<id>; next spec fix refused 'already in sprint'. assign() writes backlog before the size checks. Expected: a rejected command writes nothing. Minor.

title: spec fix bloats the sprint file; roadmap byte budget counts done sprints
note: bugs.txt pt 18: each item title repeated 3x (~250 B/item), so 20+ remarks need two fix sprints; roadmap.md 2048 B counts done sprints waiting for UAT. Proposal: Goal one sentence, one AC 'each item resolved'; done sprints outside the budget. Minor.

title: start-check prices a fix sprint from feature-sprint analogs
note: bugs.txt pt 19: 13 small remarks priced 76-207 M from an n=1 analog of 293 files; here two remark sprints both got a generic 4-16 M. Proposal: own analog class for bugfix sprints or price per item from fix-sprint history. Minor.

title: Dead background task session leaves the run stalled unnoticed
note: bugs.txt pt 20: launched session hit ENOTFOUND, stopped; nothing noticed it for ~1 h (brief: ordered, watch: working from the PO session). Proposal: check first step after launch, relaunch once, then push; brief/watch show stalled. Check what applies with the driver on. Major.

title: Reading run state with state changes the run
note: bugs.txt pt 20: state called only to read added the PO session to the task sessions and set the task started. Expected: a read-only way (state without side effects or state --peek). Minor.

title: verify treats a missing interpreter as red tests and sends it to repair
